title: Consumer Prices Index annual inflation
description: CPI annual rate for the United Kingdom.
sourceName: ONS Consumer price inflation, UK: December 2025
evidence: The Consumer Prices Index (CPI) rose by 3.4% in the 12 months to December 2025, up from 3.2% in the 12 months to November.

title: Consumer Prices Index monthly inflation
description: CPI month-on-month rate for the United Kingdom.
sourceName: ONS Consumer price inflation, UK: December 2025
evidence: On a monthly basis, CPI rose by 0.4% in December 2025, compared with a rise of 0.3% in December 2024.

title: Consumer Prices Index including owner occupiers' housing costs annual inflation
description: CPIH annual rate for the United Kingdom.
sourceName: ONS Consumer price inflation, UK: December 2025
evidence: The Consumer Prices Index including owner occupiers' housing costs (CPIH) rose by 3.6% in the 12 months to December 2025, up from 3.5% in the 12 months to November.

title: Consumer Prices Index including owner occupiers' housing costs monthly inflation
description: CPIH month-on-month rate for the United Kingdom.
sourceName: ONS Consumer price inflation, UK: December 2025
evidence: On a monthly basis, CPIH rose by 0.4% in December 2025, compared with a rise of 0.3% in December 2024.

title: Core CPIH annual inflation
description: CPIH excluding energy, food, alcohol and tobacco.
sourceName: ONS Consumer price inflation, UK: December 2025
evidence: Core CPIH (CPIH excluding energy, food, alcohol and tobacco) rose by 3.5% in the 12 months to December 2025, the same rate as the 12 months to November.

title: Retail Prices Index annual inflation
description: RPI annual rate for the United Kingdom.
sourceName: ONS Consumer price inflation, UK: December 2025
evidence: The annual RPI inflation rate was 4.2% in December 2025.

title: Real GDP monthly growth
description: Month-on-month growth in UK real GDP.
sourceName: ONS GDP monthly estimate, UK: February 2026
evidence: Monthly GDP grew by 0.5% in February 2026, following a growth of 0.1% in January 2026.

title: Real GDP three-month growth
period: Three months to February 2026 versus three months to November 2025
description: UK real GDP growth over the latest rolling three-month period.
sourceName: ONS GDP monthly estimate, UK: February 2026
evidence: In the three months to February 2026, compared with the three months to November 2025: Real gross domestic product (GDP) grew by 0.5%.

title: Services output three-month growth
period: Three months to February 2026 versus three months to November 2025
description: UK services output growth over the latest rolling three-month period.
sourceName: ONS GDP monthly estimate, UK: February 2026
evidence: Services output grew by 0.5% in the three months to February 2026.

title: Production output three-month growth
period: Three months to February 2026 versus three months to November 2025
description: UK production output growth over the latest rolling three-month period.
sourceName: ONS GDP monthly estimate, UK: February 2026
evidence: Production output grew by 1.2% in the three months to February 2026.

title: Construction output monthly growth
description: Month-on-month growth in UK construction output.
sourceName: ONS GDP monthly estimate, UK: February 2026
evidence: Services and production both grew by 0.5%, and construction grew by 1.0% in February 2026.

title: Retail sales volume monthly growth
description: Seasonally adjusted retail sales volume growth in Great Britain.
sourceName: ONS Retail sales, Great Britain: September 2025
evidence: Retail sales volumes are estimated to have risen by 0.5% in September 2025, following an increase of 0.6% in August 2025.

title: Retail sales volume three-month growth

description: Seasonally adjusted retail sales volume growth in Great Britain.
sourceName: ONS Retail sales, Great Britain: September 2025
evidence: Sales volumes rose by 0.9% in the three months to September 2025 (Quarter 3) compared with the three months to June 2025 (Quarter 2).

title: Online retail sales value monthly growth
description: Seasonally adjusted online spending value growth in Great Britain.
sourceName: ONS Retail sales, Great Britain: September 2025
evidence: With the monthly series, sales values rose by 1.4% over the month to September 2025.
